description:
[writes · `ads:manage` scope] Creates a Meta Instant Form on the brand's selected ad account: name, privacyPolicyUrl (https), questions (Meta question objects, e.g. { type: "EMAIL" }, { type: "FULL_NAME" }, or a CUSTOM question with label and options), optional contextCard, thankYou* fields and followUpActionUrl (same fields as the dashboard form). Same builder and limits as the dashboard. One vendor call, never retried; pass idempotencyKey to make repeats safe. Pass agentName and reason. Audited in Ads > Agent activity.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/ads/lead-forms.)

agentName.description: Which agent is acting. Shown to the owner in Ads > Agent activity.

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

contextCard.description: Optional intro card shown before the questions.

followUpActionUrl.description: Optional https URL the thank-you button opens.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional; 1-255 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -. Repeats with the same key are safe to send.

reason.description: Why the agent is doing this. Shown to the owner and kept in the audit trail.

thankYouWebsiteUrl.description: https URL; required with a VIEW_WEBSITE button.

name: ads_lead_form_create
title: Create an Instant Form (lead form)
